newsitem.title: USA: NationsBank to sell three business lines.
newsitem.headline: NationsBank to sell three business lines.

text.p: NationsBank Corp said Wednesday it will sell three lines of business within the Asset Management Group -- corporate trust, institutional trust and retirement services.
Bank of New York Co Inc has signed a letter of intent to purchase the corporate trust bond and coupon business, Charlotte, North Carolina-based NationsBank said.
Earlier, ChaseMellon Shareholder Services, a joint venture of Chase Manhattan Bank and Mellon Bank, said it would by the corporate trust stock transfer business.
Terms were not disclosed for either deal.
NationsBank said it was in discussions with potential buyers of the other two business lines.

"We want to concentrate on managing money and, as a result, we have decided to sell the administrative, processing and backroom functions of serving institutions," said Owen Shell, president of the NationsBank Asset Management Group, said in a news release.
